expectations.text: Uses .safeParse(), not the throwing .parse(), to validate the form data
Validates email with z.string().email() (or equivalent email check)
Enforces a minimum password length of 8 via .min(8)
Checks confirmPassword against password via .refine() or .superRefine(), with the error path set to confirmPassword
Exposes validation errors keyed by field (e.g. via .flatten() or issue.path), not just a single generic message
expectations.evidence: Manual loop over result.error.issues building a Partial<Record<field,string>> keyed by issue.path[0] (lines 41-47) — functionally equivalent to flatten(), just hand-rolled

expectations.text: Exports the inferred TypeScript type for the form data via z.infer<typeof schema>
